packageRules.description: The Dart SDK constraint follows from the Flutter pin (Flutter bundles Dart), so don't bump it separately.
Flutter SDK releases: the pin in pubspec.yaml's environment.flutter. Renovate regenerates pubspec.lock on the new version in the same PR.

realm_core and realm_firebase are git deps pinned to ONE full enspyrco/realm commit SHA, and Renovate can't track that: pub's `ref:` holds the SHA as its only value, so Renovate reads it as a version, finds it invalid and skips it (there is no branch recorded to follow). Disabled to say so here. Bump by hand: set both refs to the same full SHA, flutter pub get, commit pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock together.

FlutterFire majors can't land here on their own: realm_firebase (from the realm git dep above, which Renovate doesn't bump) constrains firebase_auth, cloud_firestore and firebase_storage to the current majors, every FlutterFire plugin needs a matching firebase_core, and fake_cloud_firestore tracks cloud_firestore. Raise realm_firebase's constraints in enspyrco/realm first, then re-pin realm here with these bumps in the same commit. Held on the Dependency Dashboard so they stay visible without opening PRs that can't resolve.

tiled depends on xml and tech_world pins xml directly too, so a tiled release that needs a newer xml can only resolve when both move in one PR (tiled 0.12 needed xml 7; queued apart, each failed alone).

The Flutter Gradle plugin loader ships inside the Flutter SDK, not on any Maven repository, so every lookup fails and leaves a standing warning on the Dependency Dashboard. It moves with the Flutter pin.
